title: Cheat
subtitle: 「欺騙／作弊／騙取」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中很自然的替代表達？
description: 「欺騙／作弊／騙取」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中很自然的替代表達？

words.note: 和 cheat 在「故意使人相信不真實的事」這個意思上非常接近。
words.example: He deceived customers about the true condition of the car.
words.exampleZh: 他欺騙顧客，隱瞞汽車的真實狀況。

exercises.original: The seller cheated customers about the true condition of the product.
exercises.zh: 賣家欺騙顧客，隱瞞產品的真實狀況。
exercises.upgrade: The seller deceived customers about the true condition of the product.

options.explanation: 核心是故意讓顧客相信錯誤資訊。
表示抄襲／複製，不是此處的欺騙。
偷竊不一定涉及錯誤資訊。
表示告知，沒有欺騙意味。

exercises.original: He cheated the public by making false claims.
exercises.zh: 他以虛假聲稱欺騙公眾。
exercises.upgrade: He deceived the public by making false claims.

options.explanation: false claims 是明確欺騙線索。

exercises.original: The fake website cheated users into believing it was official.
exercises.zh: 假網站欺騙使用者，令他們相信網站是官方的。
exercises.upgrade: The fake website deceived users into believing it was official.

options.explanation: deceive someone into believing... 非常自然。

words.note: 表示用計謀令某人做某事或相信某事。
words.example: They tricked him into signing the document.

exercises.original: They cheated him into signing the document.
exercises.zh: 他們騙他簽了文件。
exercises.upgrade: They tricked him into signing the document.

options.explanation: trick someone into doing 是典型結構。

exercises.original: The caller cheated her into revealing her password.
exercises.zh: 來電者騙她透露密碼。
exercises.upgrade: The caller tricked her into revealing her password.

options.explanation: 利用手段令對方做出本來不會做的事。

exercises.original: The advertisement cheated people into thinking the service was free.
exercises.zh: 廣告騙人以為服務是免費的。
exercises.upgrade: The advertisement tricked people into thinking the service was free.

options.explanation: 強調利用誤導手段令對方形成錯誤相信。

words.example: Several investors were duped by the false advertisement.
words.exampleZh: 幾名投資者被虛假廣告騙了。

exercises.original: Several investors were cheated by the false advertisement.
exercises.zh: 幾名投資者被虛假廣告騙了。
exercises.upgrade: Several investors were duped by the false advertisement.

exercises.original: She was cheated into sending money to a fake charity.
exercises.zh: 她被騙，把錢寄給假慈善機構。
exercises.upgrade: She was duped into sending money to a fake charity.

options.explanation: be duped into doing 是自然結構。

exercises.original: The victims were cheated by a convincing imitation website.
exercises.zh: 受害者被一個非常逼真的假網站騙了。
exercises.upgrade: The victims were duped by a convincing imitation website.

options.explanation: 受害者成功被假網站騙上當。

words.note: 和 cheat 在「騙錢」語境中非常接近。
words.example: The fraudster swindled elderly people out of their savings.

exercises.original: The fraudster cheated elderly people out of their savings.
exercises.zh: 騙徒騙走長者的積蓄。
exercises.upgrade: The fraudster swindled elderly people out of their savings.

options.explanation: 借款理論上會歸還，不等於詐騙。
偷竊可不涉及欺騙，和 swindle 不完全一樣。

exercises.original: They cheated customers out of thousands of dollars.
exercises.zh: 他們騙取顧客數千美元。
exercises.upgrade: They swindled customers out of thousands of dollars.

options.explanation: swindle someone out of money 是固定搭配。

exercises.original: The scheme cheated pensioners out of large sums.
exercises.zh: 這個騙局騙走退休人士大筆金錢。
exercises.upgrade: The scheme swindled pensioners out of large sums.

options.explanation: scheme + money loss 是強烈線索。

words.note: 正式、法律用語，表示非法以欺騙方式取得金錢、財物或權益。
words.example: The company was accused of defrauding customers.

exercises.original: The company was accused of cheating customers through false invoices.
exercises.zh: 該公司被指透過虛假發票詐騙顧客。
exercises.upgrade: The company was accused of defrauding customers through false invoices.

options.explanation: 法律／金融詐騙語境最自然。
太弱，且不一定涉及財產損失。

exercises.original: He was convicted of cheating investors out of millions.
exercises.zh: 他因騙取投資者數百萬元而被定罪。
exercises.upgrade: He was convicted of defrauding investors out of millions.

options.explanation: convicted 是法律語境強線索。

exercises.original: The manager used fake records to cheat the bank.
exercises.zh: 經理利用虛假紀錄詐騙銀行。
exercises.upgrade: The manager used fake records to defraud the bank.

options.explanation: 以虛假資料非法取得利益，最精確。

words.note: 非常常見的口語表達，表示用欺騙手段騙取某人的信任或金錢。
words.example: He conned tourists into paying for fake tickets.

exercises.original: He cheated tourists into paying for fake tickets.
exercises.zh: 他騙遊客購買假票。
exercises.upgrade: He conned tourists into paying for fake tickets.

options.explanation: 口語地表示利用騙術令對方付錢。

exercises.original: The salesman cheated her into buying a worthless product.
exercises.zh: 推銷員騙她購買毫無價值的產品。
exercises.upgrade: The salesman conned her into buying a worthless product.

exercises.original: They cheated him out of his deposit.
exercises.zh: 他們騙走了他的訂金。
exercises.upgrade: They conned him out of his deposit.

options.explanation: con someone out of money 是固定口語搭配。

words.note: 作動詞時表示用騙局欺騙某人，尤其涉及金錢。
words.example: They scammed dozens of people through fake online shops.
words.exampleZh: 他們透過假網店詐騙了數十人。

exercises.original: The fake online shop cheated dozens of customers.
exercises.zh: 假網店詐騙了數十名顧客。
exercises.upgrade: The fake online shop scammed dozens of customers.

options.explanation: 網上騙局語境非常自然。

exercises.original: Criminals cheated people through fake investment websites.
exercises.zh: 罪犯透過假投資網站詐騙民眾。
exercises.upgrade: Criminals scammed people through fake investment websites.

options.explanation: investment scam 是極常見搭配。

exercises.original: She realized she had been cheated after transferring the money.
exercises.zh: 轉賬後，她才發現自己被詐騙。
exercises.upgrade: She realized she had been scammed after transferring the money.

options.explanation: 付款後發現遇上騙局，非常自然。

words.note: 這是 cheat 本身最重要的固定結構之一。
words.example: He cheated his business partner out of thousands of dollars.
words.exampleZh: 他騙走生意夥伴數千美元。

exercises.original: The contractor cheated the client and took money that was not owed.
exercises.zh: 承建商騙走客戶本來不應支付的金錢。
exercises.upgrade: The contractor cheated the client out of money.
exercises.answer: cheated the client out of money

options.text: cheated the client out of money
options.explanation: 固定結構，表示以欺騙方式奪走某物。
借款理應歸還，不一定欺騙。

exercises.original: She was cheated and lost her rightful share of the inheritance.
exercises.zh: 她被騙，失去了本應得到的遺產份額。
exercises.upgrade: She was cheated out of her inheritance.

options.explanation: 不只可指金錢，也可指權利／應得份額。

exercises.original: The workers claimed the employer had cheated them and withheld wages.
exercises.zh: 工人聲稱僱主騙走了他們應得的工資。
exercises.upgrade: The workers claimed the employer had cheated them out of their wages.
exercises.answer: cheated them out of their wages

options.text: cheated them out of their wages
options.explanation: 表示被欺騙而失去應得款項。

words.note: 當 cheat 指比賽、遊戲或制度中不按規則取得優勢時很自然。
words.example: The player was punished for breaking the rules.

exercises.original: The player cheated during the match to gain an unfair advantage.
exercises.zh: 球員在比賽中違規，以取得不公平優勢。
exercises.upgrade: The player broke the rules to gain an unfair advantage.

options.explanation: 作弊通常涉及違反規則取得優勢。
可能犯錯，但不等於作弊。

exercises.original: Anyone who cheats in the competition will be disqualified.
exercises.zh: 任何在比賽中作弊的人都會被取消資格。
exercises.upgrade: Anyone who breaks the rules in the competition may be disqualified.

options.explanation: 可能違規，但不是作弊的核心意思。

exercises.original: The athlete was accused of cheating to improve the result.
exercises.zh: 該運動員被指以違規方式改善成績。
exercises.upgrade: The athlete was accused of breaking the rules to improve the result.

options.explanation: 概括性地描述不正當取得優勢。

words.note: 較正式、概括地表示以不誠實方式取得優勢。
words.example: Anyone who acts dishonestly during the exam may be disqualified.
words.exampleZh: 任何在考試中不誠實行事的人都可能被取消資格。

exercises.original: Students who cheat during the exam may be removed from the course.
exercises.zh: 在考試中不誠實行事的學生可能被取消修讀資格。
exercises.upgrade: Students who act dishonestly during the exam may be removed from the course.

options.explanation: 正式規章語境可概括作弊。

exercises.original: The rules prohibit competitors from cheating in any way.
exercises.zh: 規則禁止參賽者以任何方式不誠實行事。
exercises.upgrade: The rules prohibit competitors from acting dishonestly in any way.

options.explanation: 正式概括各種作弊行為。

exercises.original: The organization punished members who cheated for personal gain.
exercises.zh: 機構懲罰為個人利益而不誠實行事的成員。
exercises.upgrade: The organization punished members who acted dishonestly for personal gain.

words.note: 在考試／功課語境中，copy 可表示從別人那裡抄答案而作弊。
words.example: The student was caught copying from another candidate.
words.exampleZh: 學生被發現抄另一名考生的答案。

exercises.original: The student was caught cheating by looking at another candidate's answers.
exercises.zh: 學生因偷看另一名考生答案作弊而被發現。
exercises.upgrade: The student was caught copying from another candidate.

options.explanation: 直接從別人答案抄寫，是典型考試作弊。
也是學術不誠實，但此句是現場抄答案。

exercises.original: Two students cheated by using the same answers.
exercises.zh: 兩名學生以互相抄答案的方式作弊。
exercises.upgrade: Two students copied each other's answers.

exercises.original: He admitted cheating on the test by looking at his friend's paper.
exercises.zh: 他承認在測驗中偷看朋友試卷作弊。
exercises.upgrade: He admitted copying from his friend's paper during the test.

options.explanation: 偷看並抄對方答案就是 copying。
是另一種學術不誠實，不符合考試場景。

words.note: 當 cheat 指感情／婚姻不忠時，這是最自然的正式改寫之一。
words.example: He admitted that he had been unfaithful to his partner.

exercises.original: He admitted cheating on his partner.
exercises.zh: 他承認對伴侶不忠。
exercises.upgrade: He admitted being unfaithful to his partner.

options.explanation: cheat on someone 的直接正式改寫。

exercises.original: She discovered that her husband had cheated on her.
exercises.zh: 她發現丈夫曾對她不忠。
exercises.upgrade: She discovered that her husband had been unfaithful to her.

exercises.original: The relationship ended after one partner cheated.
exercises.zh: 其中一方不忠後，這段關係結束。
exercises.upgrade: The relationship ended after one partner was unfaithful.

options.explanation: 關係語境明確指感情不忠。
完全不同的 cheat 義項。

falseSynonyms.zh: 說謊不一定等於作弊或詐騙 lie 是說不真實的話； cheat 通常還涉及取得不公平優勢或騙走某物。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He lied about his age. He cheated customers out of money.

falseSynonyms.zh: 偷竊不等於欺騙 steal 可以完全不涉及欺騙； swindle / defraud 則通常透過欺騙取得財物。
抄襲只是學術作弊的一種 plagiarize 特別指把別人的文字、想法或作品冒充成自己的。
行賄不等於作弊 bribery 可以是 cheating/fraud 的手段，但核心意思是以利益換取不正當幫助。
背叛不等於一般欺騙 betray 重點是破壞信任或忠誠。 在感情語境可能和 cheat on 相關，但不是一般 cheat 的同義詞。
誤導不一定是蓄意詐騙 mislead 可以是有意或無意使人形成錯誤理解； deceive 通常更明確帶故意欺騙意味。
詞性陷阱 - fraud = 名詞，詐騙 - fraudulent = 形容詞，欺詐性的 - defraud = 動詞，詐騙
詞形不同 - cheat = 動詞／名詞 - cheater = 騙子／作弊者 - cheating = 作弊／欺騙行為
